title: StockSmart Monthly Program Fee Schedule — Minimum Spend, Storeroom Management and Bin Allowance
content:
## Monthly charges of the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program, by tier

| Tier | Monthly program spend below which the minimum fee applies, USD | Monthly minimum fee, USD | Fixed monthly storeroom management fee, USD | Bins managed without an additional bin fee | Monthly fee per bin above that number, USD |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| StockSmart Self-Scan | 500.00 | 75.00 | 0.00 | 100 | 0.75 |
| StockSmart Monthly Service | 2000.00 | 150.00 | 0.00 | 200 | 0.75 |
| StockSmart Biweekly Service | 4000.00 | 250.00 | 0.00 | 400 | 0.60 |
| StockSmart Weekly Service | 8000.00 | 400.00 | 0.00 | 800 | 0.50 |
| StockSmart Twice-Weekly Service | 20000.00 | 750.00 | 0.00 | 1500 | 0.40 |
| StockSmart Onsite Storeroom | 80000.00 | 2500.00 | 4500.00 | 5000 | 0.25 |

**What counts toward the monthly program minimum.** On every tier the measurement basis is the same: calendar-month billed replenishment and consumption.

**Storeroom management fee.** A figure of 0.00 means the tier carries no storeroom management fee; StockSmart Onsite Storeroom carries 4500.00 a month.

### Worked illustration (hypothetical program)

A hypothetical StockSmart Weekly Service program ends a month with 850 bins in the program. Its allowance is 800 bins, so 50 bins lie above it; at 0.50 each the additional bin fee for that month is 25.00. The same program with 790 bins at month end lies within its allowance and carries no additional bin fee.
